image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a fossilized Triceratops skull. The image highlights the massive bony frill with large fenestrae (openings), two long brow horns curving backward, and the beak-like rostrum. The texture is rough, porous bone, typical of a museum specimen. A black support stand is visible beneath the jaw.
